messages.subject: For Vimal Kapur and Global Regions leadership | Government relations and regional strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Jones,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Vimal Kapur, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and the Global Regions leadership team.

Honeywell's global industrial technology portfolio increasingly depends on disciplined regional execution across governments, regulators, customers, sustainability priorities and strategic partners. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters across corporate and technical teams while translating external priorities into accountable internal action.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regional stakeholder strategy, sustainability and executive coordination might support Honeywell's international growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Honeywell.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
